description: Canonical, machine-checkable record of rejected research fingerprints, mirrored from orchestration/specialist_coordination.json completion_evidence and AI_STATE.md's DURABLE NEGATIVE DATA RESULTS section. orchestration/specialist_coordination.py cross-checks any task that declares a fingerprint_id against this registry before it may be READY/IN_PROGRESS/PR_OPEN/QUEUED, and any engine proposing a new candidate should check is_rejected_fingerprint() before opening untouched OOS. A genuinely different economic hypothesis is not barred merely because its name resembles a rejected one -- see reconsideration_conditions on each entry.

entries.hypothesis: Exact-shared-timestamp completed-candle OKX mark/index basis carries incremental after-cost predictive value for 24h/7d direction.
entries.economic_mechanism: Persistent mark-index basis dislocations proxy funding/positioning pressure that mean-reverts or continues predictably enough to survive realistic trading costs.
entries.rejection_reason: The predeclared 8,000-hour chronological evidence window falsified both primary horizons after realistic costs: negative average net expectancy on 24h and on 7d.
entries.reconsideration_conditions: A materially different economic mechanism (not a re-parameterized basis threshold or a renamed feature over the same underlying signal) computed from genuinely new timestamp-safe inputs, evaluated on a fresh predeclared window with its own frozen baseline, may be proposed as a new fingerprint. Re-testing this exact fingerprint on the same or an overlapping evidence window is not legitimate reconsideration.

entries.hypothesis: Funding-rate-derived positioning pressure carries incremental after-cost predictive value for 24h/7d direction beyond the frozen training-only baseline.
entries.economic_mechanism: Extreme or persistent funding rates proxy crowded positioning that mean-reverts or precedes liquidation cascades predictably enough to survive realistic trading costs.
entries.rejection_reason: Zero incremental 24h OOS expectancy versus the frozen training-only baseline despite a positive headline return, and unstable across OOS halves (+91.5bps then -4.4bps); 7d fell below the predeclared independent-sample floor.
entries.reconsideration_conditions: A materially different economic mechanism using funding/positioning data (not a re-parameterized threshold or a renamed feature over the same funding-rate signal), with its own fresh predeclared frozen baseline and window, and at least the predeclared minimum independent OOS sample floor per horizon, may be proposed as a new fingerprint. Re-testing this exact fingerprint on the same evidence is not legitimate reconsideration.
